description:
I’m a Career Counsellor specializing in Engineering Admissions, guiding students across Maharashtra toward the right colleges and branches based on their aptitude, interests, and exam scores.

With a strong focus on clarity and practical guidance, I help students understand CAP rounds, cutoff trends, and the entire counselling process, making engineering admissions simple and stress-free.

I also collaborate with Aditya (COEP) to provide authentic and data-driven admission guidance, ensuring students receive real insights from top engineering institutions in Maharashtra.
